EC1: Hypersensitivity to the active substance [OR], to FCM [OR] or any of its excipients
EC2: Known serious hypersensitivity [AND] to other parenteral iron products
EC3: Anaemia [AND] [NOT] not attributed to iron deficiency, e.g. other microcytic anaemia
EC4: Evidence of iron overload [OR] or disturbances in the utilisation of iron
